articles.summary: We turned what we learned from hundreds of migrations into mint migrate, so your agent can move your docs from 21 platforms, prove nothing went missing, and tell you what didn't carry over.
articles.title: Migrate to Mintlify with your agent

articles.summary: We built a CLI command that gives coding agents current Mintlify guidance, and at first it changed nothing. One line in AGENTS.md, plus tighter guidance, took Claude Sonnet's pass rate on our hardest tasks from about one in five to every run.
articles.title: We gave agents better instructions

articles.summary: The first Mintlify Research post: which agents read developer docs, which ones are new, what they look for, and how we measured it.
articles.title: Who reads developer docs now

articles.summary: Mintlify Enterprise customers can now link their Claude Platform organization to Mintlify. Anthropic bills Claude API usage in assistant, agent, Autopilot, and automations directly to their Claude organization. No API key to paste, store, or rotate.
articles.title: Mintlify Enterprise now supports linked billing with Claude Platform

articles.summary: When the Mintlify assistant can't answer a question, it can now create a ticket in Plain or Zendesk with the user's details and conversation attached. Available on Enterprise plans.
articles.title: The assistant now files support tickets for you

articles.summary: A recap of our first evening at Letterform Archive, where technical writers, DevRel and engineering leaders talked about how people and agents will read, write and share knowledge.
articles.title: Why we started Context

articles.summary: We watched agents struggle through Mintlify setup, fetching multiple pages, trying wrong commands, and sending long instructions. So we built setup.md, one starting point for getting connected.
articles.title: We built one page to help AI agents set up Mintlify

articles.summary: Mintlify Enterprise now has stronger governance built into the editor. Require a review before any change goes live, and use expanded roles to control who can write, approve, and publish.
articles.title: Improved governance for your docs: reviews and expanded roles
